    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    t = int(input[0])
    idx = 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n, k = map(int, input[idx].split())
        idx += 1
        if k > n // 2:
            results.append('-1')
            continue
        p = list(range(1, n + 1))
        good_indices = set()
        for i in range(k):
            while p[i] % (i + 1) != 0:
                p[i], p[i + 1] = p[i + 1], p[i]
                if i + 1 < n and p[i + 1] % (i + 2) == 0:
                    p[i + 1], p[i + 2] = p[i + 2], p[i + 1]
        count = sum(p[i] % (i + 1) == 0 for i in range(n))
        if count == k:
            results.append(' '.join(map(str, p)))
        else:
            results.append('-1')
    print('\n'.join(results))
